note: Shared work-level glossary for the Odyssey (Murray 1919). Keys are lowercased surface wordforms as printed (an elided form without its apostrophe). One general gloss per form, never pinned to a line; sentence notes carry context.

glossary.αἰγίσθοιο: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; gen. sg.
glossary.αἰθίοπας: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian, one of a people living at the world’s edge; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰτιόωνται: αἰτιάομαι — blame, accuse; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis (= Attic αἰτιῶνται)
glossary.αἱμυλίοισι: αἱμύλιος — wheedling, cajoling; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴγισθος: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; nom. sg.
glossary.αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said)
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg.
glossary.βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
glossary.γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
glossary.γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
glossary.γαιήοχος: γαιήοχος — epithet of Poseidon: ’earth-holder’ (or ’earth-carrier’; the derivation is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
glossary.γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλαφυροῖσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γῆμ: γαμέω — marry; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (γῆμ’ = ἔγημε)
glossary.δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαίεται: δαίω — divide, rend · or the distinct verb δαίω — kindle, burn; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: of the heart, ’is torn’ or ’burns’
glossary.δεδαίαται: δαίω — divide; perf. 3 pl. mp., epic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’are divided’
glossary.δενδρήεσσα: δενδρήεις — wooded, full of trees; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.διάκτορον: διάκτορος — epithet of Hermes, meaning unknown, traditionally ’guide, messenger’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
glossary.δυσμόρῳ: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δυσομένου: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); pres. part. gen. sg.: ’setting’
glossary.δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
glossary.δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
glossary.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
glossary.εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’)
glossary.εἴπομεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. 1 pl.: ’we told’
glossary.εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’he may tell’
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
glossary.θέλγει: θέλγω — enchant, bewitch, beguile; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
glossary.θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
glossary.θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
glossary.θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
glossary.θόωσα: Θόωσα — Thoösa, a sea-nymph, daughter of Phorcys and mother of Polyphemus by Poseidon; nom. sg.
glossary.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’
glossary.καλέσαντα: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having called’
glossary.καλυψὼ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, the nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island, her name built on καλύπτω ’hide, conceal’; nom. sg.
glossary.κατακτείνει: κατακτείνω — kill outright, slay; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατερύκει: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
glossary.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
glossary.κεχρημένον: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεχόλωται: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; perf. 3 sg. (state): ’is angry’
glossary.κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’
glossary.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
glossary.κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
glossary.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κρειόντων: κρείων — ruling, lord; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’among those who rule’
glossary.κρονίδη: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, patronymic/epithet of Zeus; voc. sg.
glossary.κυκλώπεσσι: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.κύκλωπος: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; Polyphemus, son of Poseidon, is the one Odysseus blinded; gen. sg.
glossary.λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
glossary.λαθοίμην: λανθάνω — mid. λανθάνομαι forget (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I could forget’
glossary.λιλαιομένη: λιλαίομαι — long for, yearn (+ inf.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λόγοισιν: λόγος — word, speech, story (rare in Homer, whose usual words are μῦθος, ἔπος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέδοντος: μέδω — rule, be lord of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’ruling, lord of’
glossary.μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
glossary.μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μακράς: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μαλακοῖσι: μαλακός — soft, gentle; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
glossary.μεθήσει: μεθίημι — let go, relax, release; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.μενέαινεν: μενεαίνω — rage, be furious (built on μένος); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.μετεκίαθε: μετακιάθω — go to, visit, go after; aor. 3 sg. (can carry pluperfect force: ’had gone to visit’)
glossary.μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’)
glossary.μιγεῖσα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; mid./pass. ’unite with’ (+ dat.), the standard expression for sexual union; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
glossary.μνάασθαι: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. inf., epic diectasis (= Attic μνᾶσθαι)
glossary.μνήσατο: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, call to mind (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.μνηστήν: μνηστή — wooed and lawfully wedded; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μνηστήρεσσιν: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
glossary.μοῦσα: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of poetic inspiration; voc. sg.
glossary.μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
glossary.μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
glossary.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.μῆλ: μῆλον — sheep or goat, flock-animal; neut. acc. pl. (elided μῆλ’)
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νέηται: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
glossary.νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, notice, take note of; aor. inf.: ’to glimpse, to notice’
glossary.νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
glossary.νόσφι: νόσφι — apart from, except (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφῃ: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; dat. sg.
glossary.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
glossary.οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
glossary.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position)
glossary.οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
glossary.οἶδεν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. (with pres. sense): ’knows’
glossary.οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’
glossary.οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — his own, her own; possessive adj. (distinct from the relative ὅς); masc. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also the relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (not the possessive): ’in whom’ (ἑταίρους ... οἷσι μάλιστα πεποίθεα)
glossary.οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
glossary.οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
glossary.οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
glossary.πάθεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθεν)
glossary.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’
glossary.πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
glossary.πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πέμψαντες: πέμπω — send; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sent’
glossary.πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
glossary.πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
glossary.περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
glossary.περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — revolve, come round; aor. part. gen. pl.: ’as they revolve, rolling round’ (of the years)
glossary.περιφραζώμεθα: περιφράζομαι — consider from every side, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us devise’
glossary.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’)
glossary.πευσόμενον: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn by asking; fut. part. masc. acc. sg., expressing purpose: ’to inquire’
glossary.πεφευγότες: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having escaped (and remaining safe)’
glossary.πεφυγμένος: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’escaped, clear of’
glossary.πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε)
glossary.πλάγχθη: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was driven astray’
glossary.πλάζει: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
glossary.πολύτροπον: πολύτροπος — of many turns, much-turning (much-travelled, or versatile and wily; both senses debated); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφημον: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops blinded by Odysseus, son of Poseidon; acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
glossary.ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’
glossary.προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
glossary.πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
glossary.πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
glossary.πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
glossary.πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
glossary.πότνι: πότνια — lady, mistress; title of respect for goddesses; fem. nom. sg. (elided πότνι’)
glossary.πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
glossary.πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
glossary.σπάρτην: Σπάρτη — Sparta, city in the Peloponnese, home of Menelaus; acc. sg.
glossary.σπέσσι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single cave), epic -εσσι
glossary.σφάζουσι: σφάζω — slaughter, slay (esp. for sacrifice); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.σφετέρῃσιν: σφέτερος — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σφῇσιν: σφός — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
glossary.τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
glossary.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε)
glossary.τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
glossary.τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
glossary.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj.
glossary.τίσις: τίσις — payment, vengeance, requital; nom. sg.
glossary.ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
glossary.τηλόθ: τηλόθι (elided τηλόθ’) — far off, at a distance; adverb of place, epic (-θι suffix ’place where’)
glossary.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’)
glossary.τοιαῦτά: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; neut. acc. pl. ’such things’
glossary.τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
glossary.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
glossary.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
glossary.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’)
glossary.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
glossary.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’
glossary.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
glossary.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’)
glossary.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’
glossary.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’)
glossary.φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’
glossary.φίλου: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. (φίλοι ’kin, dear ones’)
glossary.φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
glossary.φόρκυνος: Φόρκυς — Phorcys, an old sea-god, father of Thoösa; gen. sg.
glossary.φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
glossary.φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., no augment (= ἔφυγον)
glossary.χαρίζετο: χαρίζομαι — do a favor, please, gratify; impf. 3 sg., no augment; + dat.
glossary.χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
glossary.ψυχὴν: ψυχή — life, soul, life-breath; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀέθλων: ἄεθλος — trial, labor, contest (Attic ἆθλος); gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἄθλων)
glossary.ἀέκητι: ἀέκητι — against the will of, in despite of; + gen.
glossary.ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl. ’good things’
glossary.ἀγαμεμνονίδης: Ἀγαμεμνονίδης — son of Agamemnon, i.e. Orestes; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’)
glossary.ἀμφιρύτῃ: ἀμφίρυτος — sea-girt, flowed round on all sides; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
glossary.ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀνιόντος: ἄνειμι — go up, rise (of the sun); pres. part. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀντία: ἀντίος — opposite, against; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, + gen.
glossary.ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντιθέῳ: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀντιόων: ἀντιάω — meet, come to share in; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀντιῶν); + gen.
glossary.ἀπέτισεν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay in full, atone for; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀπειπέμεν: ἀπεῖπον (from ἀπαγορεύω) — speak out, give notice, forbid; aor. inf., epic (-έμεν = Attic ἀπειπεῖν)
glossary.ἀποθρῴσκοντα: ἀποθρῴσκω — leap up from, spring up; pres. part. acc. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀπόλοιτο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, die; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., expressing a wish
glossary.ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
glossary.ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντην: Ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, traditionally ’slayer of Argus’ though the sense is disputed; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρνύμενος: ἄρνυμαι — strive to win, earn; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀσκελὲς: ἀσκελής — unyielding, stubborn; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.ἀσπερχὲς: ἀσπερχής — without pause, vehement; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.ἀτασθαλίῃσιν: ἀτασθαλίη — wanton folly, reckless wrongdoing; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, restless (of the sea; exact sense uncertain); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀφείλετο: ἀφαιρέω — take away, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, i.e. the Greeks; acc. pl.
glossary.ἁδινὰ: ἁδινός — close-packed, thronging, in a mass; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἁθρόα: ἁθρόος — all together, in a mass; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἁθρόοι: ἁθρόος — all together, in a mass; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἁμόθεν: ἁμόθεν — from some point or other (a word found once in Homer); adv., with suffix -θεν ’from’
glossary.ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
glossary.ἄγεθ: ἄγετε (elided ἄγεθ’) — come now! (interjectional imperative of ἄγω); 2 pl.
glossary.ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
glossary.ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, one who shares the bed; acc. sg.
glossary.ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
glossary.ἄστεα: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄτλαντος: Ἄτλας — Atlas, the Titan who holds the pillars of sky and sea; gen. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
glossary.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
glossary.ἐλέαιρον: ἐλεαίρω — pity, have compassion on (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); impf. 3 pl., no augment
glossary.ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
glossary.ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
glossary.ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); nom. sg.
glossary.ἐντρέπεται: ἐντρέπομαι — turn towards, pay regard to, heed; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.
glossary.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
glossary.ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
glossary.ἐοικότι: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, be deserved; perf. part. dat. sg. masc./neut.
glossary.ἐπεκλώσαντο: ἐπικλώθω — spin (fate) for, allot by spinning; aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπιλήσεται: ἐπιλανθάνομαι — forget; fut. 3 sg. mid.; + gen.
glossary.ἐπιμνησθεὶς: ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι — think of, call to mind; aor. pass. part. nom. sg. masc.; + gen.
glossary.ἐποτρύνω: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. subj. 1 sg. (purpose clause)
glossary.ἐριδαινέμεν: ἐριδαίνω — quarrel, strive, contend; pres. inf., epic (-έμεν = Attic ἐριδαίνειν)
glossary.ἐρρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — protect, rescue, save; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
glossary.ἐσελεύσομαι: εἰσέρχομαι — go into, enter; fut. 1 sg., epic (ἐς- for εἰς-)
glossary.ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐτέρπετο: τέρπομαι — take delight in, enjoy oneself; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐυπλοκάμῳ: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
glossary.ἐύσκοπον: ἐΰσκοπος — keen-sighted, sure of aim; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑκατόμβης: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, large sacrifice (lit. of a hundred oxen); gen. sg.
glossary.ἑρμείαν: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; acc. sg.
glossary.ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; nom. sg.
glossary.ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
glossary.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
glossary.ἔκταν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. (ἔκτανε, elided ἔκταν’)
glossary.ἔλθῃσι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔλθῃ)
glossary.ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
glossary.ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
glossary.ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα, elided ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
glossary.ἔπερσεν: πέρθω — sack, destroy, lay waste; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment
glossary.ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
glossary.ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἔσχατοι: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost, last; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
glossary.ἔχῃσιν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔχῃ)
glossary.ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
glossary.ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
glossary.ἡβήσῃ: ἡβάω — reach young manhood, come of age; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἡμέτερε: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
glossary.ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
glossary.ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
glossary.ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
glossary.ἤσθιον: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 pl.; with κατά in tmesis = κατήσθιον ’were devouring’
glossary.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
glossary.ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’
glossary.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whose, of whom/which (fem. gen. sg.)
glossary.ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
glossary.ἰθάκηνδ: Ἰθάκηνδε (elided Ἰθάκηνδ’) — to Ithaca, homeward to Ithaca; with directional suffix -δε
glossary.ἱέμενος: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. press forward, be eager; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἱέμενός: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. press forward, be eager; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’
glossary.ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
glossary.ἱμείρεται: ἱμείρομαι — long for, yearn for; pres. 3 sg. mid. (also serves as short-vowel subjunctive); + gen.
glossary.ἱρὰ: ἱερός (shortened ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacrifices’
glossary.ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
glossary.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
glossary.ὀδυρόμενον: ὀδύρομαι — lament, grieve; pres. part. acc. sg. masc.
glossary.ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
glossary.ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
glossary.ὀδυσῆι: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; dat. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆι)
glossary.ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
glossary.ὀλέθρῳ: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; dat. sg.
glossary.ὀλοόφρονος: ὀλοόφρων — baleful-minded (sense of this epithet, e.g. for Atlas, is debated; perhaps ’all-knowing’); gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλυμπίου: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὀμφαλός: ὀμφαλός — navel; also the boss of a shield; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρέσταο: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon who avenged him; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ὀρέστης: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon who avenged him; nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνομεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, send speeding; aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ὀτρύνωμεν)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῦ: ὀφθαλμός — eye; gen. sg. (with a verb of depriving: ’of his eye’)
glossary.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
glossary.ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
glossary.ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
glossary.ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
glossary.ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
glossary.ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
glossary.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’)
glossary.ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
glossary.ὅου: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (ὅου = Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε
glossary.ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
glossary.ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’)
glossary.ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
glossary.ὑπερίονος: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun-god; gen. sg.
glossary.ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’)
glossary.ὕπατε: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὠγυγίην: Ὠγυγίη — Ogygia, the island of Calypso; acc. sg.
glossary.ὠδύσαο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry at, hate; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ending -αο (= Attic -ω)
glossary.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’)
glossary.ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
glossary.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
glossary.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
glossary.ῥέζοι: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
glossary.αἴθωνα: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming, fire-bright (of iron the exact sense is disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αὐλείου: αὔλειος — of the courtyard; masc./neut. gen. sg. (οὐδοῦ ἐπ’ αὐλείου ’the threshold of the court’)
glossary.αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ): ’himself’
glossary.αὐτοῖσι: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’for them, to them’ (dat. of persons served)
glossary.αὐτοῖσιν: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable): ’to them, for them’
glossary.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’)
glossary.αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
glossary.βάλλουσι: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. 3 pl.: of a thought, ’put (into the heart)’
glossary.βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
glossary.βλάπτουσι: βλάπτω — hinder, baulk, trip up (not yet ’harm’, as later); pres. 3 pl. + gen. of separation: ’baulk (him) of (his way)’
glossary.βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
glossary.βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
glossary.γέροντ: γέρων — old man; masc. acc. sg., elided (γέροντ’ = γέροντα)
glossary.γλαυκῶπιν: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γουνὸν: γουνός — rise of ground, hillside, knoll; acc. sg.
glossary.γρηὶ: γρηῦς — old woman; dat. sg. (Attic γραῦς)
glossary.δάμνησι: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, tame; pres. 3 sg., epic ending -ησι
glossary.δέσματ: δέσμα — bond, fetter; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέσματ’ = δέσματα)
glossary.δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; dat. sg.
glossary.δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δαιδάλεον: δαιδάλεος — cunningly wrought, of skilled work; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαιτρὸς: δαιτρός — carver, one who portions out meat; nom. sg. (from δαίομαι ’divide’)
glossary.δατεῦντο: δατέομαι — divide, portion out, share; impf. 3 pl. mid., Ionic contraction (δατεῦντο = δατέοντο): ’were portioning out’
glossary.δεξιτερὴν: δεξιτερός — right, on the right hand; fem. acc. sg. (epic = Attic δεξιός)
glossary.δηρόν: δηρός — long, lasting; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for long, for a long time’
glossary.δμῳαὶ: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman (fem. of δμώς); nom. pl.
glossary.δουροδόκης: δουροδόκη — spear-rack, spear-stand (δόρυ + δέχομαι); gen. sg.
glossary.δώμασιν: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’over his house’
glossary.δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
glossary.δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg.
glossary.εἰδομένη: εἴδομαι — seem, make oneself like, appear as (+ dat.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg. · also functioning as aor. part. (the same -όμενος form serves both in Homer), ’having made herself like’ (Μέντορι εἰδομένη)
glossary.εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰδῶ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 sg.: ’that I may know’
glossary.εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
glossary.εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
glossary.εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
glossary.εἴδατα: εἶδαρ — food, dish; neut. acc. pl. εἴδατα: ’dishes’
glossary.εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.εἴρηαι: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire (epic = Attic ἔρομαι); pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρῃ): ’you should ask’
glossary.εἴσιδ: εἰσοράω — catch sight of, look upon; aor. 3 sg., elided (εἴσιδ’ = εἴσιδε)
glossary.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’
glossary.εἷσεν: ἵζω — seat, set; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’seated (her)’
glossary.εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
glossary.εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast; impf. 3 pl., epic diectasis (by-form of εὔχομαι)
glossary.εὐχόμεθ: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow; pres. 1 pl., elided (εὐχόμεθ’ = εὐχόμεθα)
glossary.εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
glossary.εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
glossary.ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάμ: θαμά (elided θάμ’) — often, again and again; adv.
glossary.θέτο: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’set (for himself)’
glossary.θαλπωρή: θαλπωρή — warmth, comfort; nom. sg. (from θάλπω ’warm’)
glossary.θαμὰ: θαμά — often, again and again; adv.
glossary.θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’)
glossary.θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour (with footstool); acc. sg.
glossary.θρόνους: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; acc. pl.
glossary.θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
glossary.θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
glossary.θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις)
glossary.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
glossary.κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; nom. sg.
glossary.κίονα: κίων — pillar, column; fem. acc. sg. (κίων is feminine in this use)
glossary.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’)
glossary.καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’)
glossary.καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κανέοισιν: κάνεον — basket; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.καρήνων: κάρηνον — head, peak, summit; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
glossary.κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.κατήλυθον: κατέρχομαι — come down, put in (from the sea); aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl. (identical form): ’they came down’ (of Telemachus and Athena reaching the ship) · also aor. 1 pl.: ’we came down’ (forced by the following verb)
glossary.κατερύκεται: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is held back’
glossary.κείμεν: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (κείμεν’ = κείμενα): ’lying’
glossary.κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, journey, voyage; gen. sg.
glossary.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’
glossary.κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖνόν: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic γ’)
glossary.κλισμούς: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. pl.
glossary.κλισμὸν: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. sg.
glossary.κοτέσσεται: κοτέομαι — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel: ’is angered’
glossary.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
glossary.κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
glossary.κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν with ει for ε (= Attic κρεῶν)
glossary.κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); acc. pl.
glossary.κρητῆρσι: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); dat. pl.
glossary.κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’)
glossary.λάβῃσιν: λαμβάνω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic λάβῃ)
glossary.λαέρτην: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; acc. sg.
glossary.λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά)
glossary.λῖτα: λίς — smooth linen cloth; acc. sg.
glossary.μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be an object of concern (impersonal, + dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
glossary.μέντης: Μέντης — Mentes, a Taphian chieftain, the guise Athena takes; nom. sg.
glossary.μέντῃ: Μέντης — Mentes, a Taphian chieftain, the guise Athena takes; dat. sg.
glossary.μακρὴν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαντεύσομαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine (from μάντις); fut. 1 sg.
glossary.μεθέπεις: μεθέπω — come after, follow, come to (a place); pres. 2 sg.: ’you are coming’
glossary.μεθήμενος: μέθημαι — sit among (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεμήλει: μέλω — be a care; plpf. 3 sg. used with impf. force: ’was a care’
glossary.μετελθών: μετέρχομαι — come among, go after; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (+ dat.)
glossary.μολπή: μολπή — song, singing (joined with dancing); nom. sg.
glossary.μυθήσεαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, relate; fut. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic μυθήσῃ)
glossary.μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’
glossary.νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt)
glossary.νήποινον: νήποινος — unpunished, without payment (νη- + ποινή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.νίζον: νίζω — wash; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were washing’
glossary.νίψασθαι: νίζω — wash; aor. inf. mid., purpose: ’to wash themselves’
glossary.νεμεσήσεαι: νεμεσάω — feel indignation at, take amiss (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic νεμεσήσῃ)
glossary.νεμεσσήθη: νεμεσάω — feel indignation, be indignant; aor. pass. 3 sg., double σ metrical
glossary.νηίῳ: Νήιον — Neion, a height in Ithaca; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.νηυσίν: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν) (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηῦς: ναῦς — ship; nom. sg., epic νηῦς
glossary.ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
glossary.ξεστὴν: ξεστός — planed smooth, polished (from ξέω); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. pl.
glossary.ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
glossary.ξὺν: σύν (epic ξύν) — with, together with; + dat.
glossary.οἰνοπέδοιο: οἰνόπεδος — wine-bearing, planted with vines; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἰνοχοεύων: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., lengthened epic form
glossary.οἰωνῶν: οἰωνός — bird of omen; gen. pl.
glossary.οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour meant is unsettled); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; possessive adj., neut./masc. dat. pl. (ν-movable): ’his own’ (agreeing with δώμασιν) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl.: whom (λαῶν οἷσιν ἄνασσε), not the possessive
glossary.οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
glossary.οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
glossary.οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’
glossary.πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
glossary.πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
glossary.πίνακας: πίναξ — platter, wooden trencher; acc. pl.
glossary.παλάμῃ: παλάμη — palm, hand; dat. sg. (dat. of place: ’in her palm’)
glossary.παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
glossary.παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
glossary.παρέθηκε: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.παρέθηκεν: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable)
glossary.παρενήνεον: παρανηνέω — heap up beside; impf. 3 pl., reduplicated, augment inside the compound
glossary.παρεόντων: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντων): ’of what was at hand’
glossary.παρτιθεῖ: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; pres. 3 sg., epic contracted (παρτιθεῖ = παρατίθησι)
glossary.πασσάμενος: πατέομαι — partake of, taste (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having partaken of’
glossary.πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
glossary.πατρώιοι: πατρώιος — inherited from one’s father, ancestral; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πατρώιός: πατρώιος — inherited from one’s father, ancestral; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεζὸν: πεζός — on foot; masc. acc. sg., predicative with the subject of an infinitive
glossary.περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’)
glossary.πεσσοῖσι: πεσσός — a piece in a board game (’draughts’, game and pieces unidentified); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical
glossary.πευθοίαθ: πυνθάνομαι — hear, learn, perceive; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο for -ντο, elided and aspirated (πευθοίαθ’ = πευθοίατο): ’might hear’
glossary.πλέων: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πνοιῇς: πνοιή — breath, blast; fem. dat. pl., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic πνοαῖς)
glossary.ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
glossary.ποικίλον: ποικίλος — inlaid, elaborately wrought, dappled; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’)
glossary.πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολυμήχανός: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful (πολύς + μηχανή); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πολυτρήτοισι: πολύτρητος — much-pierced, full of holes; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’
glossary.ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποτοῖο: πότος — drink, drinking; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’with drink’
glossary.πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν)
glossary.προθύροιο: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προθύροις: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; adv./prep. + gen.
glossary.προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.προχόῳ: πρόχοος — pitcher, jug (for pouring); dat. sg.
glossary.πρότιθεν: προτίθημι — set out, set before; impf. 3 pl., epic short ending -εν (= Attic προετίθεσαν)
glossary.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc.
glossary.πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
glossary.πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
glossary.πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect
glossary.πόθι: πόθι — where?; interrog. adv. (Attic ποῦ), suffix -θι of place where
glossary.πόληος: πόλις — city; gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πόλινδε: πόλις — city; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’to the city’
glossary.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
glossary.πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
glossary.πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’)
glossary.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’)
glossary.σιδήρεα: σιδήρεος — of iron; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηρᾶ)
glossary.σκέδασιν: σκέδασις — a scattering, dispersal; acc. sg.
glossary.σπόγγοισι: σπόγγος — sponge; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); acc. pl.
glossary.στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
glossary.στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
glossary.σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
glossary.σχὼν: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having held’
glossary.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat.
glossary.σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
glossary.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
glossary.τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει)
glossary.τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’
glossary.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
glossary.ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
glossary.ταφίοισι: Τάφιοι — the Taphians, an island people led by Mentes; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ταφίων: Τάφιοι — the Taphians, an island people led by Mentes; gen. pl.
glossary.ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
glossary.τελέεσθαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖσθαι)
glossary.τεμέσην: Τεμέση — Temese, a place known for its copper/bronze; acc. sg.
glossary.τετιημένος: τετίημαι — be grieved, be downcast (defective, perf. with pres. force); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
glossary.τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, privilege, worth; acc. sg.
glossary.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
glossary.τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
glossary.τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
glossary.τούτοισιν: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’to these men’
glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj.
glossary.τοῖσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.; also relative: ’with whom’ (accented τοῖσίν before the enclitic τε)
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο)
glossary.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
glossary.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’
glossary.φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
glossary.φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
glossary.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε)
glossary.φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φημίῳ: Φήμιος — Phemius, the singer in Odysseus’ house; dat. sg.
glossary.φιλήσεαι: φιλέω — treat as a φίλος, i.e. give a guest what a guest is owed (not only ’love’); fut. 2 sg. mid./pass., uncontracted (= Attic φιλήσῃ)
glossary.φιληρέτμοισιν: φιλήρετμος — oar-loving, fond of the oar (φίλος + ἐρετμόν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.φορμίζων: φορμίζω — play the lyre (from φόρμιγξ); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φράσσεται: φράζομαι — consider, devise; fut. 3 sg. mid., double σ metrical
glossary.φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
glossary.φῇσιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σι(ν): ’says, may say’
glossary.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν)
glossary.χέρνιβα: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands (χείρ + νίζω); acc. sg.
glossary.χαλεποὶ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be free with, give freely of (+ gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’)
glossary.χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
glossary.χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χρή: χρή — there is need (of); impersonal verb, + acc. of person and gen. of thing
glossary.χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.χρυσοῖό: χρυσός — gold; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic χρυσοῦ), accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε
glossary.χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.ἀέκοντα: ἄκων — unwilling; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀέκων (= Attic ἄκοντα): ’against his will’
glossary.ἀίξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγήνορες: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀγροῦ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀγροῦ ’out in the country’) · also plain gen. sg. dependent on a noun, ’of the field/farmland’: ἀγροῦ ἐπ’ ἐσχατιήν ’to the edge of the farmland’
glossary.ἀγχιάλοιο: Ἀγχίαλος — Anchialus, father of Mentes, ’near the sea’; gen. sg., epic -οιο
glossary.ἀγόρευσον: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκαχμένον: ἀκαχμένος — sharpened, of obscure formation; perf. pass. part. masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl.
glossary.ἀλλοθρόους: ἀλλόθροος — of foreign speech, speaking another tongue (ἄλλος + θρόος); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλλότριον: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, another’s; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard plot; gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμβρόσια: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιπόλῳ: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνάσσοι: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσω: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
glossary.ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
glossary.ἀναβήμεναι: ἀναβαίνω — go up (from the coast inland); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἀναβῆναι)
glossary.ἀναθήματα: ἀνάθημα — ornament, crowning glory (from ἀνατίθημι ’set up, add’; not yet ’votive offering’); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνεβάλλετο: ἀναβάλλω — mid. strike up (a song); impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνιηθεὶς: ἀνιάω — distress, vex; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, distressed’
glossary.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’)
glossary.ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
glossary.ἀποιχομένοιο: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be departed; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
glossary.ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
glossary.ἀρησαίατ: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο, elided (ἀρησαίατ’ = ἀρησαίατο): ’they would pray’
glossary.ἀρχῆς: ἀρχή — beginning; gen. sg. (ἐξ ἀρχῆς ’from the start’)
glossary.ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
glossary.ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀφίκεο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, come to; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφίκου)
glossary.ἀφνειότεροι: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; comparative masc. nom. pl., + gen. of what one is rich in
glossary.ἁδήσειεν: ἁδέω — have had enough of, take no pleasure in; aor. opt. 3 sg., negative purpose after μή
glossary.ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg.
glossary.ἄγριοι: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
glossary.ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄμμι: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν)
glossary.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
glossary.ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
glossary.ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
glossary.ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
glossary.ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for herself)’ · also of a man: ’bound on (for himself)’ (Μενέλαος … ἐδήσατο καλὰ πέδιλα)
glossary.ἐκεῖνος: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron. (full form, beside the shortened epic κεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαφρότεροι: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; comparative masc. nom. pl., + acc. of respect
glossary.ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμισγόμεθ: μίσγω — mix, mingle; mid. meet, associate with (+ dat.); impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἐμισγόμεθ’ = ἐμισγόμεθα)
glossary.ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
glossary.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
glossary.ἐπίστροφος: ἐπίστροφος — much-visiting, going about among (+ gen.); nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
glossary.ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπιδήμιον: ἐπιδήμιος — in one’s own land, at home (ἐπί + δῆμος); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιθεῖσα: ἐπιτίθημι — lay on, add; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having laid on’
glossary.ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
glossary.ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro to, come round to; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐρυκανόωσ: ἐρυκανάω — hold back, keep back (by-form of ἐρύκω); pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis, elided
glossary.ἐσθῆτός: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; gen. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
glossary.ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐυξόου: ἐΰξοος — well-planed, well-polished (ἐϋ- + ξέω); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’
glossary.ἐφεστάμεν: ἐφίστημι — stand at, be set over; perf. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic ἐφεστάναι)
glossary.ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
glossary.ἑρπύζοντ: ἑρπύζω — creep, crawl; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑρπύζοντ’ = ἑρπύζοντα)
glossary.ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα)
glossary.ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
glossary.ἔκτοθεν: ἔκτοθεν — outside, away from (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
glossary.ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔροιτο: ἔρομαι — ask; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., purpose after ἵνα: ’might ask’
glossary.ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι)
glossary.ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
glossary.ἔτερπον: τέρπω — delight, cheer; impf. 3 pl.: ’were delighting (their heart)’
glossary.ἔφαντ: φημί — say, assert; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἔφαντ’ = ἔφαντο): ’they were saying’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
glossary.ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν)
glossary.ἔχοι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
glossary.ἕστηκεν: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’stands, lies at anchor’
glossary.ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
glossary.ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
glossary.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
glossary.ἡγεῖθ: ἡγέομαι — lead, lead the way; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεῖθ’ = ἡγεῖτο, aspirated before ἡ)
glossary.ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated
glossary.ἤειδε: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., augment shown as η-
glossary.ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
glossary.ἥδ: ἥδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron. (fem. of ὅδε), fem. nom. sg., elided (ἥδ’ = ἥδε)
glossary.ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
glossary.ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
glossary.ἰδοίατο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -ατο (Attic ἴδοιντο), from the root of εἶδον
glossary.ἰθάκηνδε: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to’: ’to Ithaca’
glossary.ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
glossary.ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε)
glossary.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
glossary.ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’used to go, come’ · also as a simple narrative past, ’went’ (μνηστῆρες … ἴσαν ’the suitors went’), not necessarily iterative
glossary.ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 sg. mid./intrans. (neut. pl. subject with sg. verb): ’were standing’
glossary.ὀίομαι: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, imagine; pres. 1 sg., uncontracted
glossary.ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
glossary.ὀξέι: ὀξύς — sharp; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
glossary.ὀρυμαγδῷ: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, loud confused noise; dat. sg.
glossary.ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, picture to oneself, foresee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
glossary.ὀτρηροὶ: ὀτρηρός — quick, brisk, busy (of the family of ὀτρύνω); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁπποίης: ὁποῖος — of what sort; interrog./indef. adj. used directly, fem. gen. sg., double π epic (Ionic η for Attic α)
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj.
glossary.ὅττεό: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic gen. sg. neut. ὅττεο (= Attic οὗτινος), governed by χρή
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι)
glossary.ὑγρὴν: ὑγρός — wet, moist; fem. acc. sg. used substantively: ’the wet (sea)’
glossary.ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑπερφιάλοισι: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’)
glossary.ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
glossary.ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
glossary.ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
glossary.ῥείθρῳ: Ῥεῖθρον — Rheithron, ’stream’, a harbour in Ithaca; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
glossary.αἴγισθον: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσχεα: αἶσχος — disgrace, shame, shameful thing; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἴσχη)
glossary.αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’)
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
glossary.γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, happen; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
glossary.γαμέεσθαι: γαμέω — marry; pres. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γαμεῖσθαι): of a woman, ’be married’
glossary.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’
glossary.γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενοίατο: γίγνομαι — become; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic γένοιντο): ’would become’
glossary.γούνασι: γόνυ — knee; dat. pl., epic γούνασι (= Attic γόνασι)
glossary.γόνον: γόνος — birth, offspring, begetting, stock; acc. sg.
glossary.γόους: γόος — weeping, wailing, lament; acc. pl.
glossary.γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δάμη: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδάμη): ’was laid low’
glossary.δαίνυσθαι: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι feast, banquet; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.δαίς: δαίς — feast, banquet (of shared portions); nom. sg.
glossary.δεύτατος: δεύτατος — last; superl. adj., masc. nom. sg. (from δεύτερος ’second’)
glossary.δεύῃ: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of, need; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic δέῃ), + gen.
glossary.διέπτατο: διαπέτομαι — fly away, fly off; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (δι-έ-πτατο)
glossary.διαρραίσουσι: διαρραίω — break in pieces, destroy utterly; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeking’
glossary.δοκέουσι: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δοκοῦσι)
glossary.δολόμητιν: δολόμητις — guileful, crafty-minded (δόλος + μῆτις); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δουλιχίῳ: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca (exact location unknown); dat. sg.
glossary.δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear, shaft; acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
glossary.δυναμένοιο: δύναμαι — be able, be powerful; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’of great power’
glossary.δόλῳ: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning; dat. sg.: ’by guile’
