glossary.μάστακα: μάσταξ — mouth (poetic word, root of μασάομαι ’chew’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέσσοισιν: μέσος — middle; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, substantival: ’in the midst’
glossary.μεμιγμένα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; perf. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’mixed in’
glossary.μενεήναμεν: μενεαίνω — be eager, strain toward, be impatient; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented: ’we were eager’
glossary.μετέστενον: στένω — groan, lament, mourn over; impf. 1 sg., in compound μετα- (μετέστενον): ’I lamented over’
glossary.μητιόεντα: μητιόεις — cunning, subtly wrought; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φάρμακα (from μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’)
glossary.μιγείη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’should be mixed, had been mixed’
glossary.μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’
glossary.μύθοις: μῦθος — word, speech, story; masc. dat. pl.: ’with stories’ (μύθοις τέρπεσθε)
glossary.νηπενθές: νηπενθής — grief-banishing, that eases grief; neut. nom./acc. sg. (νη- privative + πένθος ’grief’)
glossary.νοσφισσαμένην: νοσφίζομαι — forsake, part from, abandon; aor. part. mid. fem. acc. sg.: ’having forsaken’
glossary.νωλεμέως: νωλεμέως — without a break, relentlessly, unyieldingly; adv.
glossary.ξεστῷ: ξεστός — smoothed, planed (of worked wood); masc. dat. sg. (ἵππῳ ξεστῷ ’the horse of polished wood’)
glossary.οἰκῆι: οἰκεύς — household slave, servant; masc. dat. sg. (οἰκῆι ἐοικώς ’like a household slave’)
glossary.οἰνοχοῆσαι: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, act as wine-pourer; aor. inf. act.: ’to pour the wine’
glossary.οἶκόνδ: οἶκόνδε — homeward, to one’s house; adv., -δε suffix of direction, elided (οἶκόνδ’ = οἶκόνδε)
glossary.πίεζεν: πιέζω — press, squeeze, throttle; impf. 3 sg., in tmesis (ἐπὶ … πίεζεν = ἐπίεζεν): ’pressed down upon’
glossary.παιήονός: Παιήων — Paieon, a healing god distinct from Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.παρῖζεν: παρίζω — sit down beside; impf. 3 sg., augment fused in the long ῑ: ’sat down beside’
glossary.παῖδά: παῖς — child, son, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’
glossary.περίστειξας: περιστείχω — walk around, circle round; aor. 2 sg.: ’you walked around’
glossary.πλεῖος: πλεῖος — full (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.: ’full of’
glossary.πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πολέων: πολύς — much, many; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted epic πολέων (= Attic πολλῶν): ’of many’
glossary.πολλήν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg.: ’much’ (φρόνιν … πολλήν ’much knowledge’)
glossary.πολύδαμνα: Πολύδαμνα — Polydamna, wife of Thon, an Egyptian woman; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πορφύρε: πορφύρεος — purple; neut. acc. pl., elided (πορφύρε’ = πορφύρεα), agreeing with ῥήγεα
glossary.προδόμῳ: πρόδομος — forecourt, front part of the house; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front, in one’s presence; adv.
glossary.πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
glossary.σάωσε: σαόω — save, keep safe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔσωσε, from σῴζω)
glossary.σιδηρέη: σιδήρεος — of iron, iron; fem. nom. sg. (κραδίη σιδηρέη ’a heart of iron’, image of an unbreakable will)
glossary.σπεῖρα: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping, rag; neut. acc. pl. (σπεῖρα κακά ’foul rags’)
glossary.στορέσαι: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. inf. act.: ’to spread’
glossary.στόρεσαν: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they spread’
glossary.τάπητας: τάπης — carpet, rug; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τέρπεσθε: τέρπομαι — take delight in, enjoy (+ dat.); pres. mid. indic. 2 pl.: ’you take delight’
glossary.τέτραπτο: τρέπω — turn; pass. plpf. 3 sg.: ’had been turned, had turned’ (κραδίη τέτραπτο νέεσθαι ’her heart had turned to return’)
glossary.ταλασίφρονός: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; masc. gen. sg., accented before enclitic εἰσι (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.ταναήκεϊ: ταναήκης — long-edged, long-pointed; masc. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (ταναός ’long’ + ἀκή ’edge, point’)
glossary.τανύπεπλος: τανύπεπλος — long-robed; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Helen (τανύ- ’long’ + πέπλος ’robe’)
glossary.ταρπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ dat.); aor. subj. mid. 1 pl.: ’we may take our fill’
glossary.τοῖα: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φάρμακα: ’such (drugs)’
glossary.τράπεθ: τρέπω — turn; aor. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (τράπεθ’ = τράπετε): ’turn (us), send (us)’
glossary.τρώεσσ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., elided (Τρώεσσ’ = Τρώεσσι)
glossary.τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.τρῳαὶ: Τρῳαί — the Trojan women; fem. nom. pl. (feminine of Τρῶες)
glossary.τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
glossary.φάρμακα: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or harmful); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.φωνὴν: φωνή — voice; fem. acc. sg., internal accusative with ἴσκουσα: ’making (her) voice (like)’
glossary.χαῖρ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (χαῖρ’ = χαῖρε): ’rejoiced’
glossary.χρῖον: χρίω — anoint; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔχριον)
glossary.ἀβάκησαν: ἀβακέω — be struck speechless with amazement; aor. 3 pl. (ἀ- privative + the root of βάζω ’speak’)
glossary.ἀγαθόν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. sg.: ’good, a good thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’)
glossary.ἀεικελίῃσι: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, degrading, shameful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀκούσαμεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠκούσαμεν), + gen.: ’we heard’
glossary.ἀλέεινεν: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, evade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (Attic would lengthen to η-): ’evaded’
glossary.ἀλόχοισιν: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, dative of comparison: ’like (to) the wives’
glossary.ἀμειβομένη: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply, exchange (words); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’answering’
glossary.ἀμφαφόωσα: ἀμφαφάω — feel, touch all over; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., uncontracted diectasis (= Attic -ῶσα): ’feeling it all over’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. nom. dual, doubling the dual pronoun for emphasis: ’both of us’
glossary.ἀνέγνων: ἀναγιγνώσκω — recognize; aor. 1 sg., augment fused (ἀνα- + ἔγνων): ’I recognized’
glossary.ἀναφῆναι: ἀναφαίνω — reveal, disclose, bring to light; aor. inf. act.: ’to reveal’
glossary.ἀνηρώτων: ἀνερωτάω — ask, question; impf. 1 sg., augment fused (ἀνα- + ἠρώτων): ’I questioned’
glossary.ἀπήγαγε: ἀπάγω — lead away, take away; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led away’
glossary.ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀφικέσθαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. inf. mid.: ’to arrive’
glossary.ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’
glossary.ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group
glossary.ἄεθλοι: ἄεθλος — trial, contest, ordeal, labor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλγιον: ἄλγος — pain, grief; comparative adv. ἄλγιον used absolutely: ’an added grief, all the more painful’
glossary.ἄντικλος: Ἄντικλος — Antiklos, an Achaean at Troy, mentioned only here in the poem; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄτην: ἄτη — ruinous blindness, delusion (sent by a god), ruin; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄχολόν: ἄχολος — free from anger, anger-easing; neut. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε (ἀ- privative + χόλος ’bile, anger’)
glossary.ἐβούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; impf. 3 sg.: ’he wished’
glossary.ἐβόησας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you cried out’
glossary.ἐδάην: δάω — learn, get to know; aor. pass./dep. 1 sg., augmented, root δα-: ’I have learned’
glossary.ἐκώκυον: κωκύω — wail, cry aloud (esp. a woman’s ritual lament); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’wailed’
glossary.ἐλέξατο: λέχομαι — lie down, lay oneself down to sleep; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’lay down’ (πὰρ δ’ Ἑλένη … ἐλέξατο ’beside him lay Helen’)
glossary.ἐμβαλέειν: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, cast upon; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic ἐμβαλεῖν): ’to throw on’
glossary.ἐνέηκε: ἐνίημι — put in, send into; aor. 3 sg., augmented, augment ἐ- uncontracted before the root’s own long η (= Attic ἐνῆκε): ’put it in’
glossary.ἐνήμεθα: ἧμαι (compound ἐν-) — sit in; impf. 1 pl.: ’we sat, we were sitting’ (ἵππῳ ἔνι … ἐνήμεθα ’where we sat inside the horse’)
glossary.ἐνίσποις: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might tell’
glossary.ἐνθέμεναι: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐνθεῖναι): ’to put in’
glossary.ἐνόησ: νοέω — perceive, notice, devise; aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐνόησ’ = ἐνόησε): ’devised’
glossary.ἐξελθέμεναι: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐξελθεῖν): ’to go out’
glossary.ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
glossary.ἐπίληθον: ἐπίληθος — causing forgetfulness (+ gen.); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with φάρμακον: ’a forgetting (of all ills)’
glossary.ἐπελήλυθα: ἐπέρχομαι — come over, traverse; perf. 1 sg.: ’I have traversed’ (+ acc. γαῖαν)
glossary.ἐπιστάμενος: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled in; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison: ’skilled beyond (all men)’
glossary.ἐσθίεταί: ἐσθίω — eat, devour; pres. pass. 3 sg., accented before enclitic μοι: ’is being eaten up’
glossary.ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐφημέριός: ἐφήμερος — lasting a day, for that day; masc. nom. sg., epic ἐφημέριος, accented before enclitic γε (ἐπί + ἡμέρα)
glossary.ἐφύπερθε: ἐφύπερθε — over the top, above, on top of; adv.
glossary.ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was destined, was about to’
glossary.ἔπινον: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were drinking, they drank’
glossary.ἔρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’did, performed’
glossary.ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
glossary.ἔσχεθεν: ἔχω — have, hold, restrain; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form ending -θε(ν): ’restrained, checked’
glossary.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’
glossary.ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕσασθαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. inf. mid.: ’to wear, put on (for oneself)’
glossary.ἕσπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., elided (ἕσπετ’ = ἕσπετο): ’followed, accompanied’
glossary.ἕσσα: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. 1 sg. act., unaugmented: ’I put (garments) on (him)’
glossary.ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
glossary.ἤθελεν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 sg., augmented, + inf.: ’he wished’
glossary.ἤισκε: ἴσκω — make like, liken; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from ε-): ’made (himself) seem, likened’
glossary.ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’
glossary.ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — be enough to ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + acc./dat.: ’warded off, availed against’
glossary.ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
glossary.ἰητρὸς: ἰατρός — physician, healer; masc. nom. sg., Ionic ἰητρός (= Attic ἰατρός)
glossary.ἰούσῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’as you were going’
glossary.ἱεμένω: ἵεμαι — be eager, strain forward, be impatient; pres. part. masc. dual: ’(though) eager, straining forward’
glossary.ἴδιον: ἴδιος — private, one’s own; neut. nom./acc. sg., substantival, opp. δήμιον: ’a private matter’
glossary.ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.: ’looking like (him)’
glossary.ἴσκουσ: ἴσκω — liken, make resemble; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἴσκουσ’ = ἴσκουσα): ’making (her voice) like’
glossary.ἵππῳ: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. sg. (of the wooden horse of Troy, ἵππῳ ξεστῷ)
glossary.ὀνομήνω: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; fut./aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I shall name’
glossary.ὀνομακλήδην: ὀνομακλήδην — calling by name, by name; adv. (formed on ὄνομα)
glossary.ὀνόμαζες: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 2 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζες): ’you called by name’
glossary.ὀρέξαι: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. inf. act.: ’to grant’ (+ acc. κῦδος ’glory’)
glossary.ὁρμηθέντε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; pass. start up, rush; aor. pass. part. masc. dual: ’having started up’
glossary.ὁρῷτο: ὁράω — see; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’he should see, might see’
glossary.ὄλωλε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. intr. 3 sg.: ’stands ruined, is lost’
glossary.ὑπακοῦσαι: ὑπακούω — listen and respond, answer (from within); aor. inf. act.: ’to answer’
glossary.ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
glossary.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’
glossary.ὤμοσα: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I swore’
glossary.αἰγύπτου: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt, the river/land; fem. gen. sg. (Αἰγύπτου προπάροιθε ’off the coast of Egypt’)
glossary.βάλλουσιν: βάλλω — throw, cast; here of launching ships into the sea; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’
glossary.βοσκομένη: βόσκω — feed, pasture; mid. graze; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (of the hind grazing)
glossary.βούλοντο: βούλομαι — wish, will, be minded; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐβούλοντο): ’they wished’
glossary.βροτῷ: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρί: ’to/for a mortal man’
glossary.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’, θείοιο/τοῖο γέροντος ’of the divine/that old man’, epithets of Proteus)
glossary.γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth)
glossary.γαλαθηνοὺς: γαλαθηνός — milk-fed, suckling, still at the breast; epic compound adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.γαστέρα: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γιγνόμενος: γίγνομαι — become; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’becoming, turning into’ (of Proteus’s shape-shifting)
glossary.γλαφυροῖσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς): ’in the hollow caves’ (σπέσσι γλαφυροῖσιν)
glossary.γλαφυρὴ: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. nom. sg. (γλαφυρὴ νηῦς ’a hollow ship’, of a ship’s rounded hull)
glossary.γναμπτοῖς: γναμπτός — bent, curved; verbal adj. of γνάμπτω ’bend’; masc. dat. pl., agreeing with ἀγκίστροισιν: ’with bent hooks’
glossary.γουνούμενος: γουνόομαι — supplicate, entreat (lit. clasp by the knees, γόνυ); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δήθ: δηθά (elided δήθ’) — for long, long since; adv., intensified by δή: ’for so long now’
glossary.δολιχὴν: δολιχός — long; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὁδόν: ’a long (journey)’
glossary.δύναιο: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid.: ’you might be able, if you could’ (εἴ πως ... δύναιο, potential condition)
glossary.δύνασαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δύνασαι/δύνῃ): ’you can, you are able’
glossary.εἰδοθέη: Εἰδοθέη — Eidothea, a sea-nymph, daughter of Proteus, who helps Menelaus; fem. nom. sg. (first appearance in the poem)
glossary.εἰρωτᾷς: εἰρωτάω (epic = ἐρωτάω) — ask, question; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰσήλυθεν: εἰσέρχομαι — go/come into, enter; epic aor. 3 sg. εἰσήλυθεν (= Attic εἰσῆλθεν): ’he came into’
glossary.εἴποιμι: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἄν: ’I would say’
glossary.εἴπῃσιν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (ν-movable, = Attic εἴπῃ)
glossary.εἴρεσθαι: εἴρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’(and) ask!’
glossary.εὐνάσω: εὐνάζω — lay to bed, lay down to rest; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will lay (you) down’
glossary.εὐνηθῆναι: εὐνάω — lay in bed; aor. pass. inf. εὐνηθῆναι, used in a middle sense: ’to lie (in bed)’
glossary.εὐρυπόροιο: εὐρύπορος — wide-wayed, with wide paths (εὐρύς + πόρος); adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὑρέμεναι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εὑρεῖν)
glossary.ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπιδαὲς: θεσπιδαής — wondrously blazing (θέσπις + δαίω ’burn’); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg., epithet of fire
glossary.καλυφθείς: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’covered, veiled’
glossary.καλῆς: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κατέφθιτο: καταφθίνω (root φθίω/φθίνω) — perish, be destroyed utterly; aor. mid. 3 sg., with κε in an unreal past condition: ’would have perished’
glossary.κατερύκομαι: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. pass. 1 sg.: ’I am held back, detained’
glossary.κατευνηθέντα: κατευνάω — lull, lay to rest; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’laid down to rest, asleep’ (of Proteus)
glossary.κείνοισιν: κεῖνος (= Attic ἐκεῖνος) — that, yonder; demonstr. pron./adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’upon those men’
glossary.κεχάροντο: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; redupl. aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they rejoiced’
glossary.κικλήσκουσι: κικλήσκω (= καλέω) — call, name; pres. 3 pl., ν lost before enclitic: ’they call (it)’
glossary.κιόντι: κίω — go, walk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as (I) went’
glossary.κνημοὺς: κνημός — mountain slope, spur, ridge; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κοιμήθημεν: κοιμάω — put to sleep; pass. lie down to rest; aor. pass. 1 pl.: ’we lay down to sleep’
glossary.κοιμήσασα: κοιμάω — lull to sleep, put to rest; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lulled to rest’
glossary.κοιμᾶται: κοιμάω — mid. lie down to rest, sleep; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’he lies down to sleep’
glossary.κρίνασθαι: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’choose!’
glossary.κρατεροῖο: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κρατερόφρονος: κρατερόφρων — strong-minded, stout of heart (κρατερός + φρήν); adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κρατερῶς: κρατερῶς — mightily, forcefully; adv. from κρατερός
glossary.κυμαίνοντα: κυμαίνω — swell, billow (of the sea, from κῦμα ’wave’); pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον: ’billowing, surging’
glossary.λέξεται: λέχομαι (root λεχ-, distinct from λέγω ’say, gather’) — lie down to rest; fut. mid. 3 sg.: ’he will lie down’
glossary.λίσσεαι: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, beseech; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic λίσσῃ)
glossary.λελαβέσθαι: λαμβάνω — take, seize, catch; perf. inf. mid. (reduplicated), stressing a firm grip: ’to get hold of, catch fast’
glossary.λιμός: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λιμὴν: λιμήν — harbor, haven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λοχησάμενος: λοχάω — lie in ambush, lie in wait; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lain in ambush’
glossary.λῦσαί: λύω — loose, release, let go; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’release!, let go!’
glossary.μάλιστά: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, accented μάλιστά before a following enclitic (γε): ’most of all, especially’
glossary.μέλλω: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to; pres. 1 sg. + inf., expressing a supposition: ’I must be...’
glossary.μένε: μένος — might, vigor, strength; neut. acc. pl. μένεα, elided μένε(’) before a vowel: ’the men’s strength’ (κατέφθιτο ... μένε’ ἀνδρῶν)
glossary.μέσσῃσι: μέσος (epic μέσσος) — middle, in the midst; fem. dat. pl. μέσσῃσι used substantively: ’among them, in their midst’ (of Proteus among the seals)
glossary.μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.μεθίεις: μεθίημι — let go, relax; mid. sense here, relax one’s effort, give up; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you give up, you slacken’
glossary.μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
glossary.μεμνῆσθαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid./pass. remember, be mindful; perf. inf. mid., pres. force: ’to be mindful’ + gen.
glossary.μινύθει: μινύθω — lessen, waste away, dwindle; pres. 3 sg. intrans.: ’wastes away’
glossary.μᾶλλόν: μάλα — very; comparative adv. μᾶλλον ’more, rather’, accented μᾶλλόν before the enclitic τε: ’all the harder’
glossary.νέποδες: νέποδες — offspring, brood; masc./fem. nom. pl., used only of these seals in Homer, ’children (of Halosydne)’; formation and precise meaning disputed
glossary.νήπιός: νήπιος — foolish, childish, witless; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented νήπιός before the enclitic εἰς
glossary.νεβροὺς: νεβρός — fawn, young deer; masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.νεηγενέας: νεηγενής — newborn, newly-born (νέος + γίγνομαι); epic compound adj., masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.νημερτής: νημερτής — unerring, infallible, truthful (νη- + ἁμαρτάνω); adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Proteus (γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής)
glossary.νημερτὴς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible, truthful; adj., masc. nom. sg., running-text (grave) accent, standing epithet of Proteus
glossary.νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νομεὺς: νομεύς — herdsman, shepherd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ξυλόχῳ: ξύλοχος — thicket, copse, lair; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’
glossary.οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’
glossary.οὐδέν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg.: ’nothing, no (word)’
glossary.οὖροι: οὖρος — a fair, favouring wind; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl., substantival: ’all of them’ (the seals)
glossary.πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
glossary.πανημερίη: πανημέριος — all day long, the whole day; adj., fem. nom. sg. used adverbially with νηῦς ἤνυσεν: ’in a whole day’s sailing’
glossary.παρακλιδόν: παρακλιδόν — aslant, evasively, swerving from the truth; rare adv.
glossary.παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’
glossary.πεδάᾳ: πεδάω — fetter, shackle, hold fast; pres. ind. 3 sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.πειρήσεται: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; fut. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.πεμπάσσεται: πεμπάζομαι — count by fives (from πέμπε, old form of πέντε); aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after ἐπήν in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he has counted them’
glossary.πεποίθεα: πείθω — persuade; mid./pass. trust, rely on; plpf. 1 sg. (impf./perf. force): ’I had come to trust, I trusted’ + dat.
glossary.πιέζειν: πιέζω — press, squeeze hard, grip; pres. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’press hard, grip!’
glossary.πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., agreeing with οὖροι: ’blowing’
glossary.πνοιῇ: πνοιή — breath, blast, breeze; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ποιήεντα: ποιήεις — grassy; adj., neut. acc. pl., epithet of ἄγκεα ’glens’
glossary.πολυβενθέος: πολυβενθής — very deep, many-fathomed (πολύς + βένθος); adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πολυκλύστῳ: πολύκλυστος — much-dashed-by-waves, much-surging (κλύζω ’surge, wash over’); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προδαεὶς: προδαείς (προ- + δαῆναι ’learn’) — having learned beforehand, having got wind of; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.προϊδὼν: προοράω — see beforehand, foresee; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρωτέος: Πρωτεύς — Proteus, the shape-shifting old man of the sea; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic Πρωτέως)
glossary.πρωτεὺς: Πρωτεύς — Proteus, the shape-shifting old man of the sea, servant of Poseidon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πωλεῖταί: πωλέομαι — come and go regularly, frequent; pres. 3 sg. mid., iterative force: ’he comes here regularly’
glossary.πόρφυρε: πορφύρω — heave, seethe, churn (properly of the sea darkening/heaving); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, applied metaphorically to a troubled heart
glossary.πώεσι: πῶυ — flock (esp. of sheep); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσι
glossary.πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
glossary.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἰθύν: ’for every (undertaking)’ · also ’the whole’ (of a single extent, not distributive ’every’): πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’, acc. of duration
glossary.στᾶσα: ἵστημι — stand, set; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (root aor. ἔστην): ’having stood, standing’
glossary.συνήντετο: συναντάω — meet, come upon; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ε+α > η), + dat.: ’she met (me)’
glossary.σχέσθαι: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. σχέσθαι, restrain oneself, hold back; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative, + gen. of separation: ’hold back (your force)!’
glossary.τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, end, limit; neut. nom./acc. sg. (indecl.), of an escape not found
glossary.τέρπεαι: τέρπω — mid. delight in, take pleasure; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τέρπῃ)
glossary.τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
glossary.τεκέσθαι: τίκτω — bring forth, beget; aor. inf. mid., of the father’s part in begetting (the act. is used of the mother’s bearing): ’to have begotten’
glossary.τεληέσσας: τεληείς — complete, fulfilling, perfect (of sacrifice, from τέλος); adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
glossary.φάρον: Φάρος — Pharos, an island off Egypt; acc. sg., proper name, first appearance in the poem
glossary.φαίνονθ: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided φαίνονθ’ (= ἐφαίνοντο), unaugmented: ’they appeared’
glossary.φαινομένηφιν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; pres. part. (dat. sg. sense) φαινομένηφιν, the rare -φι(ν) suffix, elsewhere confined to nouns, attached here unusually to a participle: ’(Dawn) as she appears’ — a genuinely rare formation
glossary.φιλομηλεΐδῃ: Φιλομηλεΐδης — Philomeleides, a legendary king of Lesbos known only from this wrestling-story; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φράζευ: φράζω — mid. think out, devise, plan; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -ευ (= Attic -ου): ’devise! plan!’
glossary.φρικὶ: φρίξ — ripple, roughening of the sea’s surface; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φώκας: φώκη — seal (the sea-animal); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
glossary.φῶκαι: φώκη — seal (the sea-animal); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χαλέπτει: χαλέπτω — be harsh to, afflict, vex (from χαλεπός); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.χαλίφρων: χαλίφρων — slack-minded, foolish (χαλάω ’slacken’ + φρήν); adj., masc. nom. sg., rare compound
glossary.ψαμάθοισιν: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀγαγοῦσα: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγκίστροισιν: ἄγκιστρον — fish-hook; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτους: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. acc. pl., substantival: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀλέηται: ἀλέομαι — avoid, escape, shun; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., after μή in a clause of fearing: ’lest he escape’
glossary.ἀλιτέσθαι: ἀλιταίνω — sin against, transgress against, offend; aor. inf. mid., with μέλλω: ’to be offending’
glossary.ἀλύξαι: ἀλύσκω — flee, escape, avoid; aor. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to escape’ (of Proteus straining to get away)
glossary.ἀλώμενοι: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμβροσίη: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, immortal; adj., fem. nom. sg., standing epithet of night
glossary.ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.ἀμφιβεβήκῃ: ἀμφιβαίνω — stride astride, bestride; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’has reached (the zenith)’
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνάλκιδες: ἄναλκις — without might, strengthless, feeble (ἀ- + ἀλκή); adj., masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.ἀναστάς: ἀνίστημι — raise up; intrans. aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀναστάς: ’having risen up, rising’
glossary.ἀνείρηται: ἀνείρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, question, inquire of; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀποπνείουσαι: ἀποπνέω — breathe out, exhale; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀργαλέην: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀργαλέος: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’(a god is) hard (for a mortal to master)’
glossary.ἀστεμφέως: ἀστεμφέως — unyieldingly, unflinchingly, without wavering; adv.
glossary.ἀφυσσάμενοι: ἀφύσσω — draw (water or wine); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having drawn (for themselves)’
glossary.ἁθρόαι: ἁθρόος — crowded together, in a mass, all together; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
glossary.ἁλιαέες: ἁλιαής — blowing off the sea, sea-borne (of winds); adj., masc. nom. pl., rare compound found only here in Homer
glossary.ἁλοσύδνης: Ἁλοσύδνη — Halosydne, an epithet-name for a sea-goddess (usually identified with Amphitrite), whose formation and exact meaning are uncertain; fem. gen. sg., kept as a proper name
glossary.ἄγκεα: ἄγκος — glen, valley, mountain-hollow; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’
glossary.ἄνευθ: ἄνευθε(ν) (elided ἄνευθ’) — far off, apart, away; adv.
glossary.ἅλιος: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. nom. sg., part of the standing epithet γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής ’the old man of the sea’ (of Proteus)
glossary.ἐδύσετο: δύω/δύνω — enter, sink into, plunge; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic sigmatic (ἐδύσετο, = Attic ἔδυ): ’she plunged (in)’
glossary.ἐλεύσεαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted: ’you shall come’ (the fixed νόστον formula)
glossary.ἐλεύσομαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I shall come’
glossary.ἐξαναδῦσαι: ἐξαναδύω — rise up out of, emerge from; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξερέῃσι: ἐξερέομαι — search out, range over, explore; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι, generalizing with ὁπότε (no ἄν/κε needed): ’ranges over’
glossary.ἐπάλαισεν: παλαίω — wrestle; aor. 3 sg., + dat. of the opponent: ’he wrestled (against)’
glossary.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; here as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἐπί ... ἤλυθεν = ἐπῆλθεν ’came on, came upon’); accented ἐπί before the following enclitic τε
glossary.ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal in addition; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπιπνείῃσιν: ἐπιπνέω — blow upon, blow after; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν, generalizing (parallel to ἐξερέῃσι): ’blows (behind it)’
glossary.ἐρύκεαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; pass. be held back; pres. 2 sg. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρύκῃ)
glossary.ἐσάωσε: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, preserve; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’saved’
glossary.ἐσσύμενόν: σεύω — set in motion, drive; mid./pass. perf. part. ἐσσύμενος, rush, be eager, strain; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ: ’straining hard, eager’
glossary.ἐυκτιμένῃ: ἐυκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded (ἐύ + κτίζω); adj., fem. dat. sg., epithet here of an island
glossary.ἐυσσέλμοισιν: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched (σέλμα ’rowing-bench, deck-beam’); adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, epithet of ships
glossary.ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
glossary.ἐφήσει: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon, launch at; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐφετμέων: ἐφετμή — command, injunction, behest; fem. gen. pl., rare epic noun
glossary.ἐφῆκεν: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν), used as an imperative: ’hold on!’
glossary.ἐύορμος: ἐύορμος — with good anchorage, well-mooring (ὅρμος ’anchorage’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
glossary.ἑρπετὰ: ἑρπετόν — creeping thing; broadly, any living creature, not narrowly reptiles; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person reflexive possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν, agreeing with εὐνήν: ’his own (lair)’
glossary.ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, cast, throw down; aor. 3 sg., here in tmesis with κατά (κὰδ δ’ ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε): ’threw down’
glossary.ἔδησε: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg., + gen. of separation: ’has bound (me) away from’
glossary.ἔλαφος: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔπεισιν: ἔπειμι (εἶμι + ἐπί) — go over, go among, inspect; pres. 3 sg., used with future sense alongside ἀριθμήσει: ’(will) go among (them), inspect’
glossary.ἔρεξα: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔρροντι: ἔρρω — wander, roam (elsewhere often ’go to ruin, go wretchedly’); pres. part. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι (elided μ’): ’as I wandered’
glossary.ἔτειρε: τείρω — wear away, distress, afflict; impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
glossary.ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they wished’
glossary.ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl. ἤματα, elided ἤματ’ before a vowel: ’(for) days’
glossary.ἤνυσεν: ἀνύω — accomplish, achieve, complete (a distance/journey); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
glossary.ἰφθίμου: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰχθυάασκον: ἰχθυάω — fish (denom. of ἰχθύς); impf. iterative 1 pl., epic -ασκ- suffix marking repeated action: ’we used to fish, we kept fishing’
glossary.ἴδησθε: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 pl., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when you see’
glossary.ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’
glossary.ὀδμήν: ὀδμή — smell, odor; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλοφύρατο: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, pity, feel compassion for; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὀλοφώια: ὀλοφώιος — baneful, harmful, deceitful (formation disputed, perhaps connected with ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); adj. used substantively, neut. acc. pl.: ’baneful arts/wiles’
glossary.ὁπλισάμεσθ: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided ὁπλισάμεσθ’ (= ὁπλισάμεσθα): ’we got (supper) ready’
glossary.ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj., here introducing a vivid simile
glossary.ὄρινα: ὀρίνω — stir, move, arouse (the heart, emotions); aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινα): ’I moved, stirred’
glossary.ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’)
glossary.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’
glossary.ὑποδμώς: ὑποδμώς — an underling, a subject slave (ὑπό + δμώς ’slave’); masc. nom. sg., a startling word applied here to Proteus as subordinate to Poseidon
glossary.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς)
glossary.ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰγίσθου: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon; gen. sg.
glossary.αἰγύπτοιο: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; also the river Nile, called by the same name; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰνότατος: αἰνός — dreadful, dire; adj., superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’most dreadful’
glossary.αἴγυπτόνδ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; acc. sg. + -δε suffix of direction, elided (Αἴγυπτόνδ’ = Αἴγυπτόνδε): ’to Egypt’
glossary.αὐδήσαντος: αὐδάω — cry out, speak aloud; aor. act. part. gen. sg. (agreeing with the person heard, governed by a verb of hearing): ’as he cried aloud’
glossary.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; intensive/personal pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’her, it’
glossary.βάλλομεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. 1 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν): ’we threw around, embraced’
glossary.βαρέα: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily’ (βαρέα στενάχοντα ’groaning heavily’)
glossary.βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.γίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγίγνετο): ’was becoming, turned into’
glossary.γυραίην: Γυραῖος — Gyraean, of Gyrae; adj., fem. acc. sg. — the place is unidentified and disputed since antiquity, kept as a proper name
glossary.γυρῇσίν: Γυραῖος — Gyraean, of Gyrae; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) — the place is unidentified and disputed since antiquity, kept as a proper name
glossary.δάμεν: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδάμησαν): ’were slain’
glossary.δένδρεον: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. sg. (Homeric by-form of Attic δένδρον)
glossary.δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δέρματ: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέρματ’ = δέρματα)
glossary.δαῆναι: δάω — learn, come to know; aor. inf. (root aorist, δαῆναι); shares its root with the disputed epithet δαΐφρων
glossary.δειπνίσσας: δειπνίζω — give a meal to, feast, entertain at dinner; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having feasted (him)’
glossary.διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
glossary.διαγλάψασ: διαγλάφω — scoop out, hollow out; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (διαγλάψασ’ = διαγλάψασα), rare verb
glossary.διείρεαι: διέρομαι — ask closely about, inquire about (intensive of ἔρομαι); pres. mid. 2 sg.
glossary.διιπετέος: διιπετής — fallen from the sky, sky-fed (Διός + πίπτω); adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., standing epithet of a great river
glossary.δοιὰ: δοιοί — two, a pair of; numeral adj., neut. acc. pl. (poetic beside δύο)
glossary.δολίην: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with τέχνην)
glossary.δολίης: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. gen. sg. (agreeing with τέχνης)
glossary.δολιχηρέτμοισι: δολιχήρετμος — long-oared (δολιχός + ἐρετμόν); adj., fem./masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), of ships
glossary.δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.δώσουσιν: δίδωμι — give, grant; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will give’
glossary.εἰδότ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εἰδότ’ = εἰδότα): ’knowing’ (οὐκ εἰδότα ’not knowing’)
glossary.εἰναλίῳ: ἐνάλιος — of the sea, marine; adj., masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.εἶδε: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. 3 sg. (εἶδε, from the same root as εἶδον)
glossary.εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, seated, stationed’
glossary.εὐνάζοντο: εὐνάζω — put to bed; mid./pass. lie down, bed oneself down; impf. 3 pl.: ’were lying down to rest’
glossary.εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed, lair, resting-place; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὔνησε: εὐνάω — lay to rest, put to bed (causative of εὕδω); aor. act. 3 sg.
glossary.ζατρεφέας: ζατρεφής — well-fed, sleek (ζα- intensive + τρέφω); adj., fem. acc. pl., rare compound
glossary.θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θερμὰ: θερμός — hot, warm; adj., neut. acc. pl. (agreeing with δάκρυα)
glossary.θούριδος: θοῦρις — impetuous, rushing, furious; adj., fem. gen. sg. (θούριδος ἀλκῆς ’furious valor’)
glossary.θυέστης: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus and father of Aegisthus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θυεστιάδης: Θυεστιάδης — son of Thyestes, patronymic of Aegisthus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλ: καλός — fair, beautiful, goodly; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with ἱερά
glossary.κήτεος: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.κήτεσιν: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κήτεϊ: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήτει)
glossary.καθεῖσεν: καθίζω — set, seat, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.
glossary.καλέων: καλέω — call, summon, invite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’calling’
glossary.κατέπεφνεν: πέφνω (defective, found only in the aorist) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. of the compound κατα-πέφνω: ’slew’
glossary.κατεκλάσθη: κατακλάω — break down, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was broken down’ (of the heart)
glossary.κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.κοιμηθείη: κοιμάω — mid./pass. κοιμάομαι, lie down to sleep; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’could sleep’
glossary.κρινάμενος: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out (for himself)’
glossary.κόλπον: κόλπος — fold, bosom (of a garment, or of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κύνει: κυνέω — kiss; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκύνει)
glossary.λάθοι: λανθάνω — escape the notice of, elude; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might escape notice, might slip by’
glossary.λέγε: λέγω — gather, count, pick out (the Homeric sense, source of the later dominant sense ’say, tell’); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλεγε): ’was counting’
glossary.λέκτο: λέγω — count, reckon; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he counted’ · also λέχομαι — lie down to rest; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he lay down’ — the identical forms of two different verbs are a deliberate wordplay
glossary.λίπεθ: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. mid. 3 sg. used passively, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (λίπεθ’ = λίπετο): ’was left behind’
glossary.λίπομεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. act. 1 pl., unaugmented: ’we left’
glossary.λίποντο: λείπω — leave behind; aor. mid. 3 pl. used passively: ’were left behind, survived’
glossary.λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λόχος: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μένομεν: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres./impf. 1 pl. (the form itself does not distinguish tense), with past force in narration: ’we waited’
glossary.μένουσ: μένω — remain, wait; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (μένουσ’ = μένουσα): ’waiting’
glossary.μεγάλῃσι: μέγας — great; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic μεγάλαις), agreeing with πέτρῃσι
glossary.μεῖνε: μένω — remain, stay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμεινε): ’remained’
glossary.μισθὸν: μισθός — wage, pay, reward; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μνήσαιτο: μιμνήσκομαι — call to mind, remember; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.μοῦνοι: μόνος (Ionic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ναῖε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’was dwelling, used to live’
glossary.νεόδαρτα: νεόδαρτος — newly flayed, freshly skinned (νέος + δέρω); adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., rare compound
glossary.νόστῳ: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. dat. sg. (ἐν νόστῳ ’on the way home’)
glossary.οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
glossary.οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj.
glossary.πάρδαλις: πάρδαλις — leopard, panther; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πέτρῃσιν: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
glossary.πίεν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιε)
glossary.παρατροπέων: παρατροπέω — turn aside, divert, put off with evasions; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παριών: πάρειμι (from εἶμι ’go’; distinct from πάρειμι ’be present’ from εἰμί, whose part. is παρών) — go past, pass by; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρῆσθα: πάρειμι (πάρα + εἰμί) — be present, be there; impf. 2 sg. (ἦσθα, ordinary also in Attic, not a distinctively epic ending — contrast the genuinely epic subjunctive ending -ῃσθα, as in ἐθέλῃσθα): ’you were present’
glossary.πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
glossary.πνείουσαν: πνέω — breathe, blow, give off (a scent); pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’breathing, giving off fragrance’
glossary.ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πρώτους: πρῶτος — first; adj., masc. acc. pl.: ’the first, foremost’
glossary.πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σκοπιῆς: σκοπιή — watch-post, lookout point, height; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σκοπός: σκοπός — watcher, watchman, lookout, scout; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
glossary.στιβαρῇσιν: στιβαρός — sturdy, strong, stout; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (of hands)
glossary.στρέψαν: στρέφω — turn; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστρεψαν): ’turned’
glossary.συμφράσσατο: συμφράζομαι — plan together with, contrive jointly (+ dat. of person, + acc. of the plan); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv.
glossary.σὸς: σός — your, yours (2 sg. possessive); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος), with impersonal χρή: ’of what’
glossary.τέσσαρα: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τέχνην: τέχνη — craft, skill, cunning device; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τελέω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass; fut. 1 sg. (contracted from τελέσω): ’I will accomplish’
glossary.τετληότι: τλάω — endure, have the heart to bear; perf. part. (τετληώς) masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’enduring’
glossary.τεῖρε: τείρω — wear down, distress, oppress; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτειρε)
glossary.τρίαιναν: τρίαινα — trident, Poseidon’s weapon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρύφος: τρύφος — a broken-off piece, fragment; neut. nom./acc. sg., rare noun
glossary.υἱέ: υἱός — son; masc. voc. sg. (Ἀτρέος υἱέ ’son of Atreus’)
glossary.φάτνῃ: φάτνη — manger, crib, stall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, kin’
glossary.φυγέειν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φυγεῖν)
glossary.φωκάων: φώκη — seal (the sea creature); fem. gen. pl.
glossary.φύλασσε: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύλασσε): ’was keeping watch’
glossary.φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
glossary.φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χέοντ: χέω — pour, shed; impf. mid. 3 pl., elided (χέοντ’ = χέοντο): ’were streaming, were being shed’ (of tears)
glossary.ψαμάθοισι: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀάσθη: ἀάω — blind, infatuate, delude (root of the goddess Ἄτη); aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was blinded, was struck with delusion’
glossary.ἀγαμέμνονα: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀδελφεὸς: ἀδελφεός (Ionic/epic by-form of ἀδελφός) — brother; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀδευκέι: ἀδευκής — bitter, harsh; adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., of disputed further derivation, glossed ’bitter’ since antiquity
glossary.ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valor, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg. (θούριδος ἀλκῆς ’furious valor’)
glossary.ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the fragrant food/substance of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνήγαγε: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led up, brought up’
glossary.ἀνίαζ: ἀνιάζω — be distressed, grow weary, be vexed; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἀνίαζ’ = ἀνίαζε)
glossary.ἀναβαινέμεν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀναβαίνειν)
glossary.ἀναρπάξασα: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, carry off; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having snatched up’
glossary.ἀνειρόμενος: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’asking’
glossary.ἀπήμονες: ἀπήμων — unharmed, unscathed, safe; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg. (νόστος ἀπήμων ’a safe homecoming’)
glossary.ἀπόλωλεν: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid.-pass. perish, be lost, die; perf. 3 sg. with vivid narrative force: ’has perished, is dead’
glossary.ἀριθμόν: ἀριθμός — number, count, total; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
glossary.ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἁλιοτρεφέων: ἁλιοτρεφής — sea-bred, sea-nurtured (ἅλς + τρέφω); adj., masc./fem. gen. pl., rare compound
glossary.ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
glossary.ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἁπτόμενος: ἅπτω — mid. ἅπτομαι, take hold of, touch (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking hold of’
glossary.ἄκλαυτον: ἄκλαυτος — unwept, without tears (ἀ- + κλαίω); adj., masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλοισίν: ἄλλος — other; adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’
glossary.ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; 3 sg., ν-movable, used with past narrative force (+ inf.): ’commands, bade’
glossary.ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
glossary.ἐξεσάωσε: ἐκσαόω (= ἐκσῴζω) — save, bring safely out of; aor. 3 sg.: ’saved, brought safely out’
glossary.ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, step upon (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’set foot upon’
glossary.ἐπελήθετο: ἐπιλανθάνομαι — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’forgot’
glossary.ἐπεμήδετο: ἐπιμήδομαι — devise, plot against (+ dat.); impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was devising against’
glossary.ἐπεσσύμεθ: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, hasten against; perf. mid. 1 pl. with pres. force, elided (ἐπεσσύμεθ’ = ἐπεσσύμεθα): ’we rushed upon’
glossary.ἐρύκομαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; pres. pass. 1 sg.: ’I am held back’
glossary.ἐσχατιήν: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, outlying land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐφαίνετο: φαίνομαι — appear, seem; impf. 3 sg.: ’was appearing, seemed’
glossary.ἐφεζόμενος: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting upon’
glossary.ἐφράσσατο: φράζομαι (mid. of φράζω) — devise, contrive, think of; aor. mid. 3 sg., with geminated σ by metre (= ἐφράσατο): ’devised’
glossary.ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, bear (along, repeatedly); impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying, bore along’
glossary.ἐχθόμενός: ἔχθομαι — be hated (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., passive sense: ’being hated’
glossary.ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
glossary.ἑξῆς: ἑξῆς — in order, one after another; adv. (by-form of ἑξείης)
glossary.ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl. (= Attic ἑταίρων)
glossary.ἑτέρωθι: ἑτέρωθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv.
glossary.ἔκβαλε: ἐκβάλλω — cast out, throw out, let slip (a word); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέβαλε)
glossary.ἔκταθεν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. pass. 3 pl. (root κτα-); its augment status is left undescribed for want of certainty: ’were slain’
glossary.ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
glossary.ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’fell into’
glossary.ἔναιε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was dwelling, lived’
glossary.ἔνδιος: ἔνδιος — at midday, at noon; adj. used adverbially
glossary.ἔνεικε: φέρω (suppletive aor. stem ἐνεκ-) — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg.; whether this form has lost an augment is uncertain: ’brought’
glossary.ἔσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι (aor. mid. of ἔχω; in tmesis ὑπὸ ... ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο) — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’promised’
glossary.ἔσχισεν: σχίζω — split, cleave; aor. 3 sg. (in tmesis ἀπὸ ... ἔσχισεν = ἀπέσχισεν): ’split off’
glossary.ἔχομεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres./impf. 1 pl. (the form does not distinguish tense), past force in narration: ’we held (on)’
glossary.ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might take, catch’
glossary.ἠοίην: ἠοῖος — of morning, at dawn; adj., fem. acc. sg. used substantively for ’the morning’ (πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’), acc. of duration
glossary.ἠυγένειος: ἠυγένειος (= ἐυγένειος) — well-maned, fine-bearded (ἐύ- + γένειον); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’
glossary.ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
glossary.ἤλθομεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came’
glossary.ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰάχοντες: ἰάχω — shout, cry out; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’shouting’
glossary.ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
glossary.ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid. (ἵξομαι), after ἔμελλε: ’to be about to reach’
glossary.ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
glossary.ὀδμή: ὀδμή — smell, odor, scent; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλοώτατος: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive, baneful; adj., superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’most deadly’
glossary.ὄλεσσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤλεσε)
glossary.ὄνειαρ: ὄνειαρ — help, benefit, remedy, boon; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot; masc./neut. dat.-instr. pl., old case-suffix -φι(ν) (= Attic ὄχοις)
glossary.ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
glossary.ὑπάλυξεν: ὑπαλύσκω — slip away from, escape; aor. 3 sg.: ’slipped away, got clear away’
glossary.ὑπερφίαλον: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, presumptuous; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑποδῦσα: ὑποδύω — dive under, slip beneath; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having dived under’
glossary.ὑψιπέτηλον: ὑψιπέτηλος — high-leaved, tall-leaved (ὑψι- + πέταλον); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὠΐσθη: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, suspect; aor. pass. (deponent) 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ᾠήθη): ’suspected’
glossary.ὤλετ: ὄλλυμι — mid. ὄλλυμαι, perish, be lost, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλετ’ = ὤλετο): ’perished’
glossary.ὤφελλες: ὀφείλω — owe, be obligated; impf. 2 sg. + inf., idiom for an unfulfilled past obligation, without ἄν: ’you ought to have...’
glossary.ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’
glossary.ῥέξῃς: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. subj. 2 sg.: ’you might perform’
glossary.ῥῖνα: ῥίς — nose; fem. acc. sg. (ὑπὸ ῥῖνα ’beneath the nose’)
